calab.description: Streaming calcium imaging from raw 1-photon Miniscope video
calab.longDescription: A streaming, in-browser pipeline that turns raw 1-photon Miniscope video into per-cell footprints and traces, frame by frame (Rust and WebAssembly, WebGPU later). Milestone 1 reads Miniscope AVI folders directly from disk and plays them back.
features: Reads Miniscope AVI folders in place, frame by frame
Never uploads or loads whole videos
Frame rate from timestamps and metadata, not the AVI header
